title: Where Are We at with Endpoint Security (Part 3: Beyond Malware Detection)? (2023 continued)

summary: No security products today can protect users’ endpoints (e.g., PCs, laptops, mobile phones, tablets) against all malware (e.g., unknown malware). The issue will persist in the next two decades unless the industry rebuilds these systems entirely.
